column7: There was one time when His Word came so clear and bold that it could have been audible. I answered Him by speaking out, it was so real. However, there was no one there but the Lord and I, so I can’t really say for sure if He spoke to me like we speak to each other.

column7: God never takes you down! He will never run you down; He only builds you up. When God speaks to you, He is speaking from the frame of reference that everything the Word says about you has already been accomplished and ACCEPTED by you. Jeremiah 33:3 says: “Call to Me, and I will answer you, and show you **GREAT AND MIGHTY** things which you do not know.” Does that sound like running you down or doom and gloom? There is NO doom and gloom in God, therefore He cannot tell you anything doomy or gloomy. You’ll have to tune in to the world’s news agency for doom and gloom.
column8: God will never bring you down! He will never belittle or demean you; He only builds you up. When God speaks to you, He speaks from the premise that everything the Word says about you has already been accomplished and has been accepted by you. Jeremiah 33:3 says, “Call to Me, and I will answer you, and show you great and mighty things which you do not know.” Does that sound like He would belittle you or speak doom and gloom? There is no doom and gloom in God whatsoever. Therefore God cannot tell you something that sounds gloomy and dark. If you want to hear doom and gloom, you will have to tune in to the world’s news outlets.

column7: Now, if God THINKS good thoughts of peace, a future, and hope toward us, why would He speak otherwise? The answer is, HE WOULDN’T, and HE DOESN’T! He only leads us UPWARD and ONWARD with great hope to provide us an expected future.
column8: Now then, if God has good thoughts toward us—peace, a future, and hope—why would He say anything different? The answer is this: He never would, and He doesn't! God, with great hope, simply leads us upward and forward to give us the future we hope for.
